item.text:
Implemented `/admin` with a per-request session role check. Non-admin sessions call Next.js `forbidden()` and render a custom 403 page; admin sessions see the dashboard.

Enabled `authInterrupts` in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3). The dashboard and error UI are in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx:6) and [forbidden.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx:4).

`npm run build` succeeded and confirmed `/admin` is dynamically rendered. The existing mock session has the `user` role, so this app currently exercises the 403 path until the session helper returns an admin session.
